root_cause.text: In ocfs2 reflink xattr header cleanup, after removing a preserved xattr entry, the code failed to adjust the 'last' pointer to reflect the new array size, and also did not clear the first entry when the entry count became 1, leaving stale metadata.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds correction of the 'last' pointer after memset: "last = &new_xh->xh_entries[le16_to_cpu(new_xh->xh_count)] - 1;" and adds an else branch to handle the xh_count==1 case by zeroing the entry and setting last to NULL. The CVE description explicitly states these two issues: "'last' pointer should be shifted by one unit after cleanup an array entry" and "current code logic doesn't cleanup the first entry when xh_count is 1."
